messages:
maria_cs: Quick sync — AcmeCorp EBR scheduled Tue 10am PT. Need final deck + runbook by EOD Mon. Primary asks: onboarding status, renewal risk, enablement plan, and a short demo. :calendar:

jake_csm: Copy. I'll own the renewal-risk slide + mitigation bullets. Can someone drop last 30d DAU + error rate?

dave_eng: On it. I'll export usage + latency charts and put them in the shared drive. Expect links in ~2h.

dave_eng: https://drive.redwood/acme/qbr/usage-latency.png

oliver_pm: I'll draft the roadmap slide and the product asks. Need a one-line exec ask (what we want them to approve).

sara_enable: I have the 45s customer success clip and a 3-minute demo script. Uploading clip now and will post the script here.

nora_qa: FYI onboarding checklist shows 3 open items: SSO config, model pinning, eval-harness runs. These are potential blockers for adoption. :warning:

jake_csm: Good catch — adding to mitigation plan. Proposed mitigation bullets: SSO playbook, 1:1 onboarding session, temporary config quickfix.

maria_cs: Action list (please ack):
- Jake: renewal slide + mitigation bullets (EOD Mon)
- Dave: usage + error charts + PNG link (today)
- Sara: demo script + upload clip (today)
- Oliver: roadmap + one-line exec ask (Mon)
- Maria: runbook + 1-page exec memo for the meeting (Mon 2pm review)
- Nora: confirm onboarding checklist status after fixes (Mon morning)

jake_csm: Acked. I'll also prepare 2 backup talking points if exec asks about pricing.

sara_enable: Demo script (draft):
```
- 30s: context & outcome
- 90s: core flows (primary feature + observability)
- 60s: business impact + next steps
```
Note: include fallback if model times out — show quick toggle to smaller model.

dave_eng: Added fallback snippet to runbook: `route -> gpt-lite` on high latency. Also logged a TODO to add circuit-breaker metric.

maria_cs: I'll draft the follow-up survey to capture NPS, clarity on timeline, and requested proof points. Plan to send within 24h post-EBR.

calendar-bot: Event created: AcmeCorp EBR — Tue 2026-05-12 17:00 UTC — attendees: Maria, Jake, Oliver, Sara, Dave, Nora

jake_csm: Can we run a 30m dry-run Mon 4pm PT? Prefer to rehearse exec script + demo handoffs.

maria_cs: Booked — Mon 4pm PT dry-run. I'll post agenda and slide order later today.

sara_enable: Quick note — include a slide that shows adoption milestones + outstanding enablement tasks so execs see traction.

maria_cs: Great — putting that on the agenda. If anyone can't make the dry-run ping me directly. I'll consolidate final deck after the run and share for sign-off. :thumbsup:
